mapper.select: SELECT encode(s.id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.spu_id AS "spuId", p.category_id AS "categoryId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.spec_json::text AS "specJson", COALESCE(s.sku_image_url::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)::text AS "skuImageUrl", s.price_yuan AS "priceYuan", s.point_exchange_enabled AS "pointExchangeEnabled", s.point_exchange_points AS "pointExchangePoints", s.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", s.status AS "skuStatus", p.status AS "spuStatus", c.status AS "categoryStatus" FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id INNER JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE s.id = #{skuId}

SELECT encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", h.status AS "status", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version" FROM product_hot_sku h WHERE h.sku_id = #{skuId} AND h.status = 'ENABLED' AND (h.start_at IS NULL OR h.start_at <= #{now}) AND (h.end_at IS NULL OR h.end_at > #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId}

WITH raw AS ( SELECT decode(item.sku_id_hex, 'hex') AS sku_id, item.quantity AS quantity FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS item( sku_id_hex text, quantity integer ) ), target AS ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity)::integer AS quantity FROM raw WHERE quantity > 0 GROUP BY sku_id ) UPDATE product_sku s SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + target.quantity, updated_at = NOW() FROM target WHERE s.id = target.sku_id
